<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **5** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **27** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **5** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/system.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/system.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/system.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**6** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`  _(via ObjectStackProtocolImplementation (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/kernel/cluster.mdx`  _(via ObjectStackProtocolImplementation (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx`  _(via TranslationDataSchema (symbol, a top-level const), globalActions (literal, a string literal in PlatformTranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationItemSchema), metadataForms (literal, a string literal in PER_APP_SETTINGS_PLATFORM_ONLY), settingsCommon (literal, a string literal in PER_APP_SETTINGS_PLATFORM_ONLY))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx`  _(via globalActions (literal, a string literal in PlatformTranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationItemSchema))_
- `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx`  _(via globalActions (literal, a string literal in PlatformTranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationItemSchema))_
- `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx`  _(via globalActions (literal, a string literal in PlatformTranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationItemSchema), metadataForms (literal, a string literal in PER_APP_SETTINGS_PLATFORM_ONLY), settingsCommon (literal, a string literal in PER_APP_SETTINGS_PLATFORM_ONLY))_

⛔ **4** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v16.mdx`  _(via ObjectStackProtocolImplementation (symbol, a top-level class), globalActions (literal, a string literal in PlatformTranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationItemSchema))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via ObjectStackProtocolImplementation (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via globalActions (literal, a string literal in PlatformTranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationItemSchema))_
- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-3.mdx`  _(via metadataForms (literal, a string literal in PER_APP_SETTINGS_PLATFORM_ONLY))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **5** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/system.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/system.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/system.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **5** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **185** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 4443014630c094cde840f9dd0b0b45ade45b48d9` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `bb21f2fd6a1fa106b3f4ac6a8f7a969edc80194c` — the merge of head `2842767b2acffbdccdd85ad9d700a229d61fbe6c` into base `4443014630c094cde840f9dd0b0b45ade45b48d9`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin bb21f2fd6a1fa106b3f4ac6a8f7a969edc80194c && git checkout bb21f2fd6a1fa106b3f4ac6a8f7a969edc80194c
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 4443014630c094cde840f9dd0b0b45ade45b48d9 2842767b2acffbdccdd85ad9d700a229d61fbe6c && git checkout -B drift-repro 4443014630c094cde840f9dd0b0b45ade45b48d9 && git merge --no-ff 2842767b2acffbdccdd85ad9d700a229d61fbe6c

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 4443014630c094cde840f9dd0b0b45ade45b48d9
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 4443014630c094cde840f9dd0b0b45ade45b48d9` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

L1: REWORK
Head-sha: ab48a19f39191102c033b67807dddf10e0e01248

### What I read at this head

- All 41 files (+606/−86) and the PR body.
- Card #34939, claim 6956466284, the part-1 branch claim 6960654625, and the seat amendment 6957676841 (route A: label only, packaged-base guard in, description out).
- The measured file list in report 6958551125 and reports 6960519645 and 6961409475.
- The check-runs on this sha.
- `check-governed-merges` on the final file list: not governed (0 of 41 paths hit the register), 692 lines.

### Checklist

**Shape.** Draft, `Fixes #34939`. The body and the changeset both carry:

- `Clause-②: yes (widening)`
- `Metadata-protocol: added`
- `Skills-docs: follow-up owed — #34962`

All three match the amendment. The UI half is #34961, which I ACCEPTed in 6959003257.

**Scope.** The files match the seat-approved measured list, plus the five extras the report names: the strictness-ledger count, the objectql bare-slot test in place of the planned metadata-protocol test, `translationTable.test.ts`, `references/api/protocol.mdx` and `references/data/mapping.mdx`. M1 adds one more file. The seat should acknowledge both in its L2.

**Changeset.** It bumps minor on spec, metadata-protocol, rest, lint, cli, app-shell and i18n, which are all the published packages whose src moved. objectql and runtime carry test edits only. The showcase is `private`.

**Code.**

- **Schema.** `mappings` is a strict per-name object with a single `label`. It refuses `description` and `fieldMapping` with guidance, and refuses `name` and `title` as aliases of `label`. Each of the three schemas gains the singular alias `mapping → mappings`. Every spelled count in `translation.zod.ts` moved: sixteen → seventeen and seventeen → eighteen. `MappingSchema.label`'s `describe()` names the key.
- **Resolver.** `translateMapping` follows the shape of `translateBook`: `labelCatalogs`, `valueOverridesPackagedBase` on `label`, the locale chain, and an empty string is not a translation. It returns the same reference when nothing applies. Registering it in `METADATA_DOCUMENT_TRANSLATORS` is the whole REST wiring.
- **Packaged base.** `'mapping'` joins `PackagedArtifactBaseType`. The facet body is `packagedArtifactBase('mapping', name)`. The protocol forwarder and the `PACKAGED_BASE_ACCESSORS` row are added.
  - The objectql real-boot suite's `SEALED_TYPES` already carries a `mapping` entry (:381), so adding it to `LABEL_ORDER_TYPES` really exercises it. I checked that it is not a vacuous filter.
- **Docblock fold (the seat's route-B condition).** I read the fold line by line against the deleted text. Every statement in the PR's home table is present in the shared docblock:
  - the #30062 opener and ADR-0146 D2;
  - the dashboard twin;
  - the twins of the page;
  - ruling 6631250894's order;
  - the measured `crm_welcome` / `OVpage` / `欢迎页` case;
  - the page's no-extension-fold note;
  - the dataset's label and measure case;
  - app node-by-`id`;
  - book group-by-`key`;
  - shadow immunity;
  - the `undefined` cases.
  
  Nothing was dropped. The other four accessors point to the shared docblock. `protocol.ts` is at 11704 ≤ 11705.
- **Lint, CLI and UI.** The walk emits the key from `label` only. The orphan table resolves stack and sibling mappings. `i18n/missing-mapping` is added. The Studio preview row, the translation table row and `SPEC_TRANSLATION_GROUPS` are added. The new UI string has both en (`Import Mappings`) and zh (`导入映射`). The studio namespace has only those two packs.

**Tests.** The commands are real and exit codes are recorded.

- Two ablations went red: the translator row (9) and the orphan row (2).
- The runtime parity pin serves `线索导入` in zh-CN and `Lead feed` in en.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` is NOT MEASURED, as declared. CI is its reading.

### Must-fix

**M1. The platform checklist's served-vocabulary clause is now false.**

The file is `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/i18n.json`, item `i18n.surface-matrix` (revision 15), `acceptance[7].clause`.

The clause scores `GET /i18n/translations/:locale` against the declared vocabulary. It spells that vocabulary as:

- "PlatformTranslationDataSchema's seventeen groups";
- "TranslationDataSchema's sixteen per-app groups";
- "so sixteen groups: apps, books, … settings, settingsCommon".

At this head these are eighteen, seventeen and seventeen, and the list has no `mappings`. The showcase bundle now serves `mappings.showcase_inquiry_feed`. A tester who follows the clause would score that key as outside the declared groups and record a false FAIL.

This is the same class as #34914's M1. Fix it in this PR:

- correct the three counts;
- add `mappings` to the named list;
- bump the item's revision from 15 to 16 with a history entry, in the file's own convention, saying whether the clause's meaning changed.

While you are there: `source[]` at :324 still describes `appTranslationDataShape` as a "fifteen-group vocabulary" without `hooks`. That staleness was there before this PR, but this PR also makes the list miss `mappings`. One sentence fixes both.

Re-run `check-governed-merges` on the final file list after adding the file.

### Should-fix

None.

### Notes

- **N1, changeset wording (nit).** The Clause-② line names "a new `MetadataProtocol.getPackagedMappingBase`". The method is on `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`. The CHANGELOG precedent for the other four accessors names that class.
- **N2, CI.** There are 74 check-runs on this sha: 62 success, 11 skipped, and 1 failure. The failure is the 20:49 `PR-body guards` run, from before the part-1 claim existed. The same check re-ran at 21:22 and is green. Everything else is green, including Test Core 1–10, Test UI 1–16, Build Core, Build Docs, Spec property liveness and Check Documentation Links. The landing head needs every run green, so the stale failure must not be the one the queue reads.
- **N3, skills.** `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` is untouched, and its group list is owed on #34962, as the Skills-docs line says.
- **N4, base drift.** origin/main has moved since the base 0465f4aa. There is no conflict now (mergeable clean). The M1 push is a good point to merge main.

### Routing

L1 REWORK on M1. A delta review from this head is enough. This is a Clause-② widening with `Metadata-protocol: added`, so the seat's L2 at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER is owed. The PR is not governed today.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f23f65d8c8f0ca12f3331ea21186e5a208247f32`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/data/mapping.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts, packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts + packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-discovery-and-bases.ts, packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts, packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts, packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts, packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-coverage.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/TranslationPreview.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/translationTable.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/utils/spec-translations.ts

Inputs read: card #34939 (body and all 7 comments: triage 6956161396, claims 6956466284 and 6960654625, seat amendment 6957676841, dev reports 6958551125, 6960519645, 6961409475, 6962332163); PR #34976 body and its 42-file list; the net diff of the head against its merge base `fb5c42d10c` (42 files, +615/-89); the check-runs on the head. Code outside the diff was read in the head's tree to judge the diff, not reviewed.

Check-runs on `f23f65d8c8` (read from the API, 74 runs): 63 success, 11 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending. The skipped ones are opt-in or queue jobs (upgrade harness, packed-tarball smoke, Temporal conformance, UI published artifacts, queue verdicts, schedule gate, dogfood shard matrix placeholders, one Auto Label and one Check PR Size duplicate). Green among them: Check Changeset (2), Spec property liveness, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards (2), Build Core, Build Docs, Type Check · workspace / source gates / consumer gates / debt ledger, Type Check UI, Test Core 1-10 of 10, Test UI 1-16 of 16, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Dogfood Regression Gate.

### ① Derived judgments

Accept-set changes the diff implies:

- `TranslationDataSchema`, `PlatformTranslationDataSchema`, `TranslationItemSchema`: a new optional key `mappings` (record of mapping name to a strict object with the single optional key `label`). It enters through `appTranslationDataShape`, which all three spread. RIGHT, a pure widening: the three doors are strict, so `mappings` was refused before and nothing that parsed is now refused.
- `ServedTranslationDataSchema`: gains `mappings` too, because it is `appTranslationDataShape` less `metadataForms`. RIGHT, and the client reader follows (`SPEC_TRANSLATION_GROUPS` in `spec-translations.ts`). The generated authorable surface carries all four rows (Platform, Served, TranslationData, TranslationItem).
- Top-level alias `mapping` to `mappings` on the three authoring doors. RIGHT: an alias on a strict object changes only the refusal text, not the accept set, and it points at a key the shape declares (the alias-integrity condition the file's own comment states).
- Inner refusals: `name` / `title` aliased to `label`; `description` and `fieldMapping` answered by guidance. RIGHT, and consistent with the seat ruling (description out: `MappingSchema` declares none). The guidance sends an author to `objects.OBJECT.fields.FIELD.label`, which is where a target field's label does translate.
- Refusal-text counts sixteen to seventeen (per-app) and seventeen to eighteen (platform). RIGHT: `appTranslationDataShape` declares exactly seventeen keys at this head (objects, picklists, apps, messages, globalActions, dashboards, datasets, reports, pages, flows, hooks, positions, permissions, books, mappings, metadataForms, settingsCommon), and the list in `PER_APP_SETTINGS_PLATFORM_ONLY` names the same seventeen in declaration order.
- `MappingSchema.label`: `.describe()` text only. RIGHT: no accept-set change; `references/data/mapping.mdx` regenerates from it.

Public-surface changes:

- `@objectstack/spec/system`: new exports `translateMapping` (function) and `MappingLike` (interface); `TRANSLATABLE_METADATA_TYPES` gains `mapping` because it is derived from `METADATA_DOCUMENT_TRANSLATORS`. RIGHT, additive; api-surface and export-origins carry both names.
- Served behaviour: `GET /meta/mapping` (list and item) now returns the mapping's `label` in the request locale when a bundle carries `mappings.NAME.label`. RIGHT as the card's ask; a deployment with no such key is served byte-identical documents (`translateMapping` returns the same reference).
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: new public method `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.getPackagedMappingBase`, new facet static, `PackagedArtifactBaseType` union gains `mapping`. RIGHT, additive.
- `@objectstack/rest`: one `PACKAGED_BASE_ACCESSORS` row. RIGHT; the accessor is looked up by name and an older protocol without it answers `undefined`, which the translator reads as the catalog applying.
- `@objectstack/lint`: `ExpectedEntry.source` gains `mapping`; the walk emits `mappings.NAME.label`; `translation-target-unknown` (error) now fires for a `mappings.NAME` naming no mapping. RIGHT and not a narrowing: before this head the whole `mappings` group was a schema refusal, so no bundle that validated can newly fail on the orphan rule.
- `@objectstack/cli`: `CoverageIssue.source` gains `mapping` (`i18n/missing-mapping`). RIGHT as a minor. It follows that an existing app with a labelled mapping and a non-default locale now reports one more coverage gap per mapping from `os i18n check`; that is the behaviour every newly walked group has had (books, #26690), and the in-repo baseline did not grow because the showcase translates its one mapping.
- `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/i18n`: a `CATEGORY_DEFS` row, two studio strings, one `WALKED_TYPE_STACK_KEYS` row, one `SPEC_TRANSLATION_GROUPS` entry. RIGHT, additive.

### ② Semver level

The changeset `.changeset/34939-translation-mappings.md` bumps `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/cli`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` at minor. That matches what the diff publishes: every one of the seven has a source change that adds a capability and none removes or refuses anything. `@objectstack/runtime` and `@objectstack/objectql` change in tests only and are correctly absent; the showcase is an example. Check Changeset is green on the head (both runs).

Clause-②: yes (widening) — correct, and consistent across the claim (6960654625), the PR body and the changeset. The line names the four schemas, `translateMapping` and `getPackagedMappingBase`. It does not name the `MappingLike` interface, which is also a new export; the api-surface baseline records it, so nothing is undeclared to a gate. `Metadata-protocol: added` is correct for a new authorable bundle key, and no ADR-0087 conversion is owed because no stored spelling is retired. `Skills-docs: follow-up owed — #34962` matches the seat's decision to keep `skills/**` out of this PR.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev report 6960519645, open question (how to clear `check:facade-delegation-only`): answered by the seat with route B, applied at `ab48a19f39` and still in the head. Judged in ④: the fold drops no statement, and the registry ceiling file is not in the diff.
- Dev reports 6961409475 and 6962332163: `open_questions` empty. Nothing to answer.
- Out-of-scope carrier `#34962` (the skill's group list): carried on the changeset's Skills-docs line. Accepted as carried, not escalated.
- The dev's NOT-MEASURED gate (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, left to CI): the head's Build Core and the lint gate families are green, so CI answered it.
- Report 6958551125's two older out-of-scope notes concern PR #34961 (the UI half) and are not this PR's.
- SQL push-down (Prime Directive 5): no finding. The diff adds no query, no id materialisation and no in-app join. The one new read per list element, `packagedObjectBaseOf` for `mapping`, is the existing synchronous in-memory registry lookup the list translation already makes for seven other types.
- Not governed: `check-governed-merges` reports 0 of 42 paths on the register, and Governed Surface Queue Guard is green.

The six files beyond the dev's measured 36-file list, each judged:

1. `docs/audits/2026-07-unknown-key-strictness-ledger.counts/system.md` (405 to 406): out of ④ scope (generated). Correct: the diff adds exactly one `strictObject` site under `packages/spec/src/system/` (the `mappings` entry), and the generated-files gate is green.
2. `packages/objectql/src/protocol-custom-override-bare-slot-envelope.test.ts`: out of ④ scope (test). Correct, and a stronger pin than the planned metadata-protocol unit test: `LABEL_ORDER_TYPES` filters `SEALED_TYPES`, which already carried `mapping` (line 381 at this head), so on a real boot, with and without a metadata service, `getPackagedMappingBase` is pinned to answer the base's own item before the override, at once and after a restart, and `undefined` for an unknown name; the same loop pins `servedOverrideBaseOf`, the pair bundle and the ruled label order through `translateMetadataDocument('mapping', …)`.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/translationTable.test.ts` (14 to 15 list reads): out of ④ scope (test). Correct: one more `WALKED_TYPE_STACK_KEYS` row is one more list read.

Every spelled count in the file (lines 997, 1042, 1081, 1085, 1086, 2592-2595, 2616, 2860 at this head) agrees with the seventeen declared keys.

`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` — `translateMapping` is `translateBook` with the description and group arms removed, line for line: same guards, `labelCatalogs`, `catalogFor(catalogs, valueOverridesPackagedBase(base, 'label', doc.label))`, same-reference return when nothing is found, a shallow copy otherwise. `lookupMappingLabel` walks `localeChain` through `pickData` and treats an empty string as no translation, as `lookupBookAttr` does. Attempts to break it:
- A pair bundle: `overlayTranslationData` merges by generic record recursion, not by a per-group list, so `mappings` needs no entry there.
- An override that changed the label, with no pair translation: `catalogFor` hands back `undefined`, the lookup returns `undefined`, the override's own text stands. The ADR-0146 D2 order the docblock states.
- No packaged base (a mapping no code package ships, or an older protocol): `valueOverridesPackagedBase` is false, so the catalog applies. As documented.
- A mapping with no authored `label`: a bundle entry is still applied, so the wizard's `label || name` shows the translation. Same as every sibling translator; harmless.
- The server import path resolves a mapping by name through the protocol, not through the translated REST read, so a translated label cannot reach import execution.
The registration comment ("registering here is the whole wiring") is true: `isTranslatableMetaType` and both `translateMetaList` and the item read derive from `TRANSLATABLE_METADATA_TYPES`. `mapping` is an overridable, row-served sealed type (`SEALED_ROW_SERVED_OVERRIDE_TYPES` in `protocol-package-bindings.ts`, and `mappings: 'concat'` in `stack.zod.ts`), so the packaged-base guard the seat ruled in is needed, not decorative.
